name: Media frost
doc: Frost crystals grow over the picture: every onset seeds nuclei on its strong edges that send out six arms, each arm a tip that the bass and onsets push forward, wandering a little, steering along the picture's contours and splitting off side branches at 60 degrees, stopping where it would touch another branch, so the frost stays feathery; each cell keeps the picture's colour as it freezes, so the ice redraws the picture over a dim, cold copy of it, the growing tips glow, each beat leaves a ring and the highs make it glint. The frost thaws, thin parts first, at every phrase start and the picture re-forms.

in.doc: the picture: the colour the ice takes and the dim copy under it (core-media.out)

edges.doc: the picture's contours: where nuclei seed and which way the branches run (core-media.edges)

palette.doc: cold tint of the bare picture, crystal colonies, rims

cells.doc: crystal grid height in cells (width follows the aspect)

react.doc: how much the bass and onsets push the tips forward

seed.doc: nuclei seeded on the edges at each onset

along.doc: how much the branches follow the picture's contours

branch.doc: how often a tip splits off a side branch (0 long needles, 1 dense feathers)

reform.doc: how much of the frost thaws at each phrase start

show.doc: brightness of the bare picture under the frost

mist.doc: cold haze over the bare picture

tint.doc: palette tint of the crystal colonies

sparkle.doc: glints on the ice with the highs
